column3: NASB has no “answering,” like the critical text; “was silent” is rendered “kept silent.”
NASB renders “from now” as “hereafter” and prints the Old Testament phrases in capitals.
NASB follows the critical text with “the blasphemy” (no “his”); “garments” is rendered “robes.”
“Deserving of death He is” is rendered “He deserves death!”
“Struck” is rendered “beat Him with their fists.”
NASB adds “it” and renders “what you say” as “what you are talking about.”
“Those having stood” is rendered “the bystanders”; “speech” is “the way you talk.”
NASB follows the critical text; “declaration” is rendered “word.”
